Definitely worth the purchase and hours of fun

Amazingly addictive, cute, horrifying, adorable, heinous, lovely and incredibly engrossing. The recent updates brought in a TON of Quality-of-Life changes, making it easier for folks who play casually and those who don't. Love the crossover with Don't Starve (Webber is best boy), and I can't recommend this game enough!

Despite how other games display roguelike-colony sim mixes, the 2D and the difficulty combined make it a unique experience. Plus, if you like MatPat or if he inspired you to REALLY like lore, there is a LOAD of lore here, it's also really easy to make little fics off of like infections and whatnot!

The game's advertising hooked me up only for me to get bored of it pretty fast. There is no depth to the game. The dialogues are as unimportant as any character in the game. You don't make any connections, everything is skippable. The roguelike aspect does not work with the babying of the cult. Oh, I want to do more fighting? Too bad, half of the cult is dying out, and I must go back. The quests get repetitive, the fighting lacks variation, the animation scenes, which you've seen a hundred times by now, are unskippable and annoying. I did not feel any initial excitement, and, after learning that the progress is just as unimportant, I still feel none of it.

Fun game, though some of post-game was pretty grindy and and just boring to just do the same thing over and over again until I got lucky, such as getting follower forms from god tears or looking for lore rooms. I also had some issues with crashes, but after reinstalling it never was an issue again. Other than very late post-game though, very enjoyable!
This is my second run through of this game, its lovely and lots of fun. All I have to say is that you might have to live with occasionally funny and occasionally game breaking bugs.
I really don't like the combat system. Hard to locate my character with axis and my eyes get pretty tired after only one hour

Very fun game, you have brought together many elements from different games and it works really great.
It doesn't get boring you have a lot to do, there are some very funny but also sometimes crazy things to experience that you just don't expect and in combination with the atmosphere it really puts you in a good mood.
Get ready to take over the power and create your own cult to assert yourself against the false prophets! ^^
I have come back to this game multiple times with multiple updates, Sins of the Flesh, Woolhaven, etc.. It has always been a phenomenal joy from start to finish. All hail the one true lamb god <3

Cute and sinister! Art and music are top notch. 

I have played several times. Its a fun roguelite game with its own cult management. 
I had already beaten the game 100% but with the new DLC, I am excited to play through again and see the new ways I can sacrifice my cult. 

Let the sacrifices begin
Really fun game overall, with challenging boss fights and a "relaxing" cult management/tycoon aspect. In general, a fun game that keeps you busy. Praise the Lamb

It has a little bit of Stardew Valley farming, a little bit of Animal Crossing villagers, and a little bit of Hades combat... and its presented in this charming, pleasing to look at art style with lots of humor and nice music throughout. The combat is pretty decent and can be very challenging depending on your difficulty. Overall would highly recommend

I could not get enough of this game for a long time. i would stay up late losing track of the time to this gem, it genuinely started affecting my sleep so I had to stop playing

I'm now getting back into it after seeing all the big content updates, its amazing to see how much they have expanded an already great and wonderfully replayable game.

Yep, I felt for the same deeply wrong fleur around this game :)
I'm a huge fan of Isaac but this game shares nothing with it except genre.

If you're looking for the deep battle system, various of enemies and artifacts - move on, you won't find it here.

But, you'll find a great meta game (village builder, workers placement and so on) + one of the most marvelous art styles I saw in indie games.

So, even that I was misled by the "Isaac comparison thing" - I deeply enjoyed this game for absolutely other reasons I started playing it for.

I love this game and in my opinion it's really fun. I mean it depends what style games you like but it's really fun to collect the little cult members and get to kind of design them, and there are some cool and interesting characters you can meet along the way. I would recommend this game. :)

stardew valley for people who employ gaslighting instead of giving gifts to make friends

fr tho this game is banging, 10/10 presentation and sound, the dungeon gameplay stuff is pretty good. but the whole building cult aspect has a much bigger component than i expected n i love it

8 hours in and my cult is flourishing, shrine and temple fully upgraded, finished the second area, this game is fantastic, way better on PC than Switch. If you want a cute cult simulator, I highly recommend it, cant wait to play with a friend in the new co-op mode! :D

the music in this game rocks.

nothing in this game is ugly.
10/10.
This game is so fun and i loved it with its awesome detail for gameplay

i love this. i love the combat even when my skill drops to floor randomly costing me the whole peak run (no hitted heket just to get bodied by kallamar 2 minutes later in a boss rush). what i need is more content my boy, i need more farming stuff, more combat stuff, hell give me *s e x* update part 2 if its necesarry, anything to keep this game going. i love going for purgatory run, pick a bad fleece for myself, die, come back with same fleece, die, repeat until i pass the whole thing.

aside from that, game is good, combat is good, base building is good, only thing you would hate will probably be getting hit by most random bullcrap while either using that 1 hit fleece or while doing the no hit achievements.

B U Y.

A very clever design mixing cute animals and horror-lite. The gameplay is varied and challenging (I find it quite hard, but I'm not great at these kinds of games). The characters and dialogue is hilarious, as well as the voice tracks. Definitely recommend if you want to try a new spin on an action game.

It's a really fun rogue-lite. The combat is nice and the base building is also nice. But I think what the game did best was blending the 2 genres together. You get materials from combat and you get upgrades from your cult. It really feels like one whole game (and not 2 games glued together as one might think).

Everything about this game is right up my alley. The aesthetic, the art style, the humor, the darkness, the mechanics. Just solid and entertaining all the way through--I'm looking forward to whatever might be added in the future but I'd already replay the hell out of this just to de-stress with this cute 'cult simulator' -- something I never thought I'd say.

Very nice Dungeon crawler with simple yet quite satisfying and addicting combat.
With randomly generated dungeons each time so while it may feel similar after a while each dungeon run doesn't feel exactly the same and RNG can either bless or curse you depending what weapons you get , what enemies will spawn and if and which Tarrot cards and Relics you get on your run.
Stop giving me hammers as weapons in most of my runs , game! I hate them and i suck with them!

Beside dungeon crawling this game is a base building "colony sim" on top of that.
Where you run a religious cult of Animal Crossing rejects where you can do (and force them to do) very messed up and horrible things.

And i do mean horrible things. Like for example one of your cult members fell in love with another? Well kill their lover , cook a meal of their flesh and force them to eat it. I know right! Fun stuff.

Oh and this game has a real banger of a soundtrack too.
I give this game 9 Jim Jones out of 10 Lamb chops

i love this game, when i see my followers turn against me, it makes me blast my bashful boy load in their faces to get them back in their place. i love walking out of the tent to smell the musk of daddies furry kittens laying on the floor for me like good boys. got me really violating the geneva convention with how much excrement be layin on the floor from my time away crusading. 10/10

Man, what a cool damn game. The base building and dungeon crawling mix so so SO well - one of the best indie games I know. Music and art style are charming and so fucking awesome - rest in peace, River Boy.
Fun strategie game with cute art mixed with some gore scenes. The story itself is interesting too and even after it you got enough to do to play for a while.
Incredibly cute dungeon crawler/ farming sim kind of game! I loved growing my own cult and deciding myself what sort of leader I wanted to be!!

This is one of my favorite games. It has so much versatility and a great community. The devs put a lot of love into this game. The art style is so cute! I initially wished it had a little more gameplay or replayability but woolhaven genuinely adds so much more content to the game! I bought COTL on literally three different platforms and absolutely adore it. It's addicting
i love this game so much, the art, the combat, the music, and the character design, i hope this game gets even better in the future and/or it becomes even bigger
A game that is a good introduction to the rogue-like genre, while also being a challenging feat for experienced players. Overall a great experience and fun gameplay!
This is such a fun game, love the taking care of the cult parts and making sure everyone's happy.

it's been a while since I experienced such a unique blend of genres and styles, it's just as brutal, violent and dark as it is funny and cute; the art style brings that contrast out even more - scratches both my base building and my roguelite itch XD can't ask for more from a game

my cult has already seen many ups and downs in the first few hours - some of my followers got old, died and been buried ( or eaten :/ ), some were sacrificed for the greater good or left with nothing but their own poop to eat :D can't wait to see what else this game has in store for me - there is also fishing !!!! :D
really liked this game. everything is very fun. i don't think the sound design gets enough credit, it's really great. hope you're having a lovely day. <3

A game I can never put down, one that always makes me smile and laugh, and a game where you'll never run out of stuff to do and always have so much fun. So so cute, well-made, aesthetically pleasing, and just an absolute joy to play. Thank you for existing Cult of the Lamb, top 5 games of all time in my opinion.
Nothing i can really say that hasn't already been said. But it was so much better than I expected it to be. Amazing game and gameplay loop with a wonderful art style.

For me Perfect mix of the Survival/maintenance elements and Combat missions, If you really only like combat games or only like survival maintenance games it wouldn't be my first pick for you however I would recommend to anyone who likes both of those genres it would be my first pick!

They love me.

Having alotta fun with the game. Adore the mix of animal crossing and issac like mechanics. Can never go wrong with some fishing either! The OST is so good as well, incredibly fitting. Everything just looks super cute too despite being horrifically messed up. It's great!
Do wish you had the ability to zoom in during gameplay. The camera mode is a lot of fun though!

A very fun rogue-like game with cute art style, If you like The binding of Isaac and Hades. I highly recommended this game.

Unfortunately unlike others rogue-like games. There is no point playing it after completed everything and earned all achievements, but still it is worth to give it a try!

I love this game so much dude

Its my first time finishing a rougelike, and I will definitely be playing more games like this and keep returning to this masterpiece.

Everything is amazing, the music, the combat, the art, and I never once felt the game was unfair at all.

I'll do another playthrough when I get Woolhaven, if its peak this shit will go from a 9 to a 10

I played the game on the launch, now I'm back again since I heard the upcoming DLC will be good and add huge new contents. I can't wait for it.
This game is nothing but a gem for me, it has its unique concept and vibe. The cute but creepy art is charming for me. The dark humor, love it.
I like the roguelike combat, smooth and challenging but not that tryhard challenging. The management and base building are also my things. It's fun to see my base is getting bigger and my followers are having fun. The story is good and after you finished the main story, there are still things to explore and collect.
While the management side isn’t overly complicated, the learning curve is reasonable even if you’re new to roguelikes / sim-management. Also I find it since the launch, the game is more stable, richer, and more polished now.

this is my 3rd copy as I own it on different ports and I have been loving playing this with it being the perfect balance of rouge-like and village simulator. I also love how the twitch integration allows viewers to add more challenges to the game!
Has so much content, and completly different types of things you can do in it, 100/10 i love this game, please buy it, so that we can convince the devs to make all the dlcs part of the game for free
This has become my favourite game of all time and I WILL be buying all of their merch ASAP whether it breaks my bank or not
cool game, perfect balance between grind, craft, mini-games, really interesting storyline but its short, now gonna see what's in dlc

Lovely art style & audio. Great setting and feeling. The game feels fresh and fun for about 10 hrs, but then the mechanics start lacking any proper depth. Neither the cult management aspect nor the dungeon crawling can hold up much after that, but it's fun while it lasts! I would recommend CotL just as long as you're not expecting something as deep as Binding of Isaac for example.

Started playing at 10pm and it's 6am, I don't know how all this time passed but it did. I love it and I want to get the DLC's because I do feel like it has an ending, but I don't want to reach the end.

Great game, lots of personality, fantastic art style and soundtrack but lackluster gameplay.

The combat is sweet and simple with a slight touch of depth but the cult part of the game is very simplistic, you have more depth building a village in terraria than in cult of the lamb but cult of the lamb is all about the cult yet somehow fails to satisfy anything more than "feed cult, mash attack and dodge roll, repeat"
It could have been so much more if the cult actually mattered, or what you built mattered, or how you treated the cult mattered but in the end of things the only thing the cult is for is to open doors that are locked behind having a certain # of followers.

The game has so much potential but it doesn't quite fit the bill as a roguelike and it doesn't fit the bill as a cult simulator, I'd recommend playing something else.

tldr.text: Overwhelmingly Positive (96%): players mostly praise the gameplay, art and music.
A common complaint is that the combat is not fun, while bugs and crashes also come up.

details.text: Recent reviews mention bugs and crashes far less often, at 3% against 8% over all time, so buyers now see fewer reports of instability.
Players with under 2 hours are far less positive than veterans, while those with over 50 hours are almost all positive.
